paper.title: March in Chat: Interactive Prompting for Remote Embodied Referring Expression
paper.central_claim: MiC combines goal-oriented static planning,room/object-aware CLIP perception and room-change-triggered LLM dynamic planning to improve REVERIE navigation and remote object grounding over pretrained HM3D-DUET.
